description: Returns the download URL of the SIGNED PDF of one document of a signature request, in the field signedDocumentUrl. Only works once the whole signature request is COMPLETED or COMPLETED_MANUAL: before that the API rejects the call, so check the status with signature_request_get first. Requires: case_file_create → caseFileId, signature_request_create → requestId, signature_document_list → documentId. For the completion certificate use signature_certificate_get; for the evidential package (a ZIP) use signature_certificate_package_url.
name: signature_document_signed_url
